attchmntText: ICDS Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: ICDS Ltd published an extract of its unaudited standalone financial results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026. The Board of Directors approved these results during a meeting held on 11 November 2026. The advertisement was published on 12 November 2026 in Udayavani and The New Indian Express. For the three months ended 30 September 2026, total revenue from operations was 79.03 Lakhs. Net profit after tax was 28.40 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.22 rupees. For the six months ended 30 September 2026, total revenue was 226.68 Lakhs. Net profit after tax was 107.36 Lakhs. Earnings per share were 0.82 rupees. Equity share capital remains at 1,302.67 Lakhs with a face value of Rs. 10 each. The full results are available on the company website and stock exchange portals.

attchmntText: ICDS Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: ICDS Limited approved unaudited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026. The Board meeting was held on November 11, 2026. For the six months ended September 30, 2026, revenue from operations was Rs. 132.35 Lakhs. Total revenue stood at Rs. 278.55 Lakhs. Profit before tax was Rs. 169.48 Lakhs. Profit after tax was Rs. 140.08 Lakhs. Earnings per share was Rs. 1.08. The company received Rs. 652.18 Lakhs in May 2022 regarding a legal dispute. The matter is pending further hearing in the Supreme Court. The company opted for the Direct Tax Vivad Se Vishwas Scheme 2024.
